title: MagAttract + Metapolyzyme Metagenomic gDNA Extraction from Urine
author: Natalie Ring
materials: Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS kit. If DNA concentration is an appropriate concentration for your experiment (for us, this means at least 0.2 ng/µl), continue to clean-up steps. Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 1 µL, DNA 199 µL, Qubit dsDNA HS working solution

Quantify DNA using Qubit dsDNA HS kit. If DNA concentration is an appropriate concentration for your experiment (for us, this means at least 0.2 ng/µl), continue to library preparation. Qubit® dsDNA HS Assay Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #Q32854 1 µL, DNA 199 µL, Qubit dsDNA HS working solution

steps.title: Pellet Urine Samples
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 2x 1.5 ml aliquots of urine in 1.5 ml tubes at maximum speed (~13,000 RPM/16,000 xg) for 20 minutes at room temperature, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Cell Pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellets and combine them in 160 µl buffer P1 (50 mM Tris, 10 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Add Metapolyzyme and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl metapolyzyme (3.3 mg/ml, 5 mg resuspended in 1500 µl PBS), mix by flicking the tube, and incubate on a thermomixer for 60 minutes at 37°C with 900 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µl MagAttract proteinase K, mix by flicking the tube, and incubate on a thermomixer for 30 minutes at 56°C with 900 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Perform lysis and bind DNA to magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µl MagAttract buffer AL and mix by pulse vortexing (10 short <1 second pulses per tube).
Vortex MagAttract Suspension G for 10+ seconds to ensure beads are well mixed (suspension should be black).
Add 15 µl MagAttract Suspension G and 280 µl MagAttract buffer MB, then mix by pulse vortexing.
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash Beads with Buffer MW1
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with buffer MW1.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl MagAttract buffer MW1 and incubate on a thermomixer for 1 minute at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking.
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove the supernatant.
Repeat these two sub-steps once more.

steps.title: Wash Beads with Buffer PE
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice with buffer PE.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl MagAttract buffer PE and incubate on a thermomixer for 1 minute at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking.
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove the supernatant.
Repeat these two sub-steps once more.

steps.title: Rinse Beads and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Perform final rinse and elute the gDNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Spin down briefly and pellet beads on a magnet.
Rinse pelleted beads on the magnetic rack with 700 µl distilled water by pipetting down the opposite wall of the tube; incubate for 1 minute on the magnetic rack.
Remove the distilled water.
Add 50 µl nuclease-free water off the magnet to resuspend the bead pellet.
Incubate on a thermomixer for 3 minutes at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking.
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on the magnetic rack, and transfer the supernatant to a low-DNA binding 1.5 mL tube (e.g., Eppendorf or Sarstedt).

steps.title: ProNex Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the DNA using ProNex beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex ProNex beads for 10+ seconds and add 150 µl (or 200 µL as per text) of room temperature ProNex beads to the DNA (approx 49 µl).
Mix well by slowly pipetting up and down 10 times.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes (no shaking).
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove the supernatant.
Rinse pelleted beads on the magnetic rack by pipetting 200 µl ProNex Wash Buffer down the opposite wall of the tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 60 seconds (no shaking), then remove the Wash Buffer.
Repeat this process once more.

steps.title: Dry and Elute Final DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the beads and perform final elution.

substeps.instruction: Air-dry the sample (lid open) on the magnetic rack for 5 minutes (up to 60 minutes).
Add 20 µl nuclease-free water off the magnet, resuspend the pellet by flicking the tube, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes (no shaking).
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and transfer the supernatant to a low DNA-binding tube.

steps.title: Final Polishing
steps.instruction: Perform final incubation and bead removal.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the eluted DNA on a thermomixer for 3 minutes at room temperature with 1,400 RPM shaking.
Spin down briefly, pellet beads on a magnet, and remove any remaining supernatant.
